# AI News Aggregator

> AI News Aggregator is a static client-side news reader that collects AI articles from selected RSS sources and presents them in a focused, filterable feed.

AI News Aggregator runs in the browser with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Source preferences and the feed cache are stored locally in the browser. RSS content is fetched client-side through public CORS proxy strategies; there is no application backend or database.

## Site

- [AI News Aggregator](https://ainews.leonemarcos.com/): Live application.
- [Repository](https://github.com/LeoneMarcos/AI-News-Aggregator): Source code, documentation, tests, and deployment configuration.
- [Showcase video](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4dfd7103-3ed0-4a76-9cd0-7a028ec64a1f): Product walkthrough.

## Technology

- [React](https://react.dev/): UI component library.
- [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/): Typed application source.
- [Vite](https://vite.dev/): Development server and production build tool.
- [Vitest](https://vitest.dev/): Test runner.
- [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/LeoneMarcos/AI-News-Aggregator/actions): Automated validation workflow.
- [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com/): Static hosting.
